notes.title: Minor Performance Optimization
notes.notes: [h1][b][u]Optimization Update[/u][/b][/h1][h3]Visual Souls and Sinners[/h3][p] Thank you for all the feedback on performance. We know Souls and Sinners can take up a significant amount of load during gameplay, and we want to make your experience smoother. With this update, the number of Souls and Sinners you see on the map now scales with your graphic settings. This change is purely visual and does not affect the actual Souls or Sinners you receive at the end of a stage or at the end of the game.[/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="149,269,"][tr][th colwidth="149"][p]Graphic Setting[/p][/th][th colwidth="269"][p]Visual Souls on Map[/p][/th][th][p]Visual Sinners on Map[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]Low[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]No Souls seen[/p][/td][td][p]No Sinners seen[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]Medium[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]1 Soul shown for every 4 spawned[/p][/td][td][p]1 Sinner shown for every 4 spawned[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]High[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]1 Soul shown for every 2 spawned[/p][/td][td][p]1 Sinner shown for every 2 spawned[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]Epic[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]1 Soul shown for every 2 spawned[/p][/td][td][p]1 to 1[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="149"][p]Cinematic[/p][/td][td colwidth="269"][p]1 to 1[/p][/td][td][p]1 to 1[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p]This adjustment was fast tracked because of your feedback. In the future, you will have more freedom to decide how many Souls and Sinners are shown on the map. Please keep sharing your thoughts. Every bit of feedback helps us make The HELL better for everyone.[/p]

notes.title: Update 5.5.0: New Notifications System, Tribute Visuals Updated and more
notes.notes: [h1]This update brings new tools and refinements to your journey through Mission 1[/h1][p][/p][h2]List of Updates 5.5.0 Brings:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Notifications System[/b] - The first iteration is here to keep you on top of resources, Sinners, and events in your domain.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tribute Visuals[/b] - Brand new look to the Tribute objective panel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Souls Movement[/b] - Refining the movement of the Souls to consume less processing and improve game performance through the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional Improvements[/b] - General fixes and inconsistencies fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Share Your Feedback[/h2][p]Join the discussion on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3733920/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url] or [url="https://discord.gg/j79qjsSJBQ"]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts as we continue refining the experience.[/p]

[h3][b]We have just released the latest updates for our game. [/b][/h3][h3][/h3][h3][b]The changes this time include;[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]- Disconnected Blood Path but the structures would function as normal [/p][p]- Media missing within the tutorial screens [/p][p]- Tutorial interactions issues if proceed too fast [/p][p]- Animation fixes on the new Decree layout [/p][p]- Added some fixes for Decrees affecting the Babel of Lies cost [/p][p]- Addressed typos & inconsistencies [/p][p]- Fixed Altar's production rate [/p][p]- Destroyed Cauldrons would block the construction of Blood Paths [/p][p]- Tweaked "Hustle and Bustle" animations [/p][p]- Fixed voiceover timings [/p]

notes.title: 🚨 PROLOGUE OFFICIAL LAUNCH – PLAY NOW! 🚨
notes.notes:
[p][b]🚨 PROLOGUE OFFICIAL LAUNCH – PLAY NOW! 🚨[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3733920/The_HELL_Prologue__City_Builder_of_the_Dead/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]As developers, this is a huge moment for us, and we’re incredibly excited to finally share it with you.[/p][p]After months of late nights, coffee-fueled discussions, design trials, and community feedback, the [b]Prologue[/b] for [i]The HELL: City Builder of the Dead[/i] is officially [b]LIVE[/b]![/p][p]This Prologue is more than just a demo, it’s your [b]first real taste[/b] of the world we’ve been building. Here’s what you can expect:[/p][p]🔹 [b]Full Episode 1[/b]
Dive into the beginning of the story, starting with [b]Namazu[/b], the Earth-Shaking Titan born from the Great Kanto Earthquake of 1923. This chapter sets the tone for the chaos, strategy, and soul-bound challenges to come.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Step-by-step Tutorials[/b]
Whether you're a city-building veteran or new to the genre, we’ve included tutorials to help you ease into our unique mechanics, from soul management to hellish construction planning.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Language Support[/b]
We’re proud to support both [b]Simplified and Traditional Chinese[/b], along with English, making sure more players can experience the depths of the underworld in their preferred language.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Free to Play[/b]
That’s right! The Prologue is [b]completely free[/b]. No payment walls, no microtransactions. Just download and jump into Hell.[/p][hr][/hr][p]This is only the beginning. Your feedback during this Prologue phase is incredibly valuable to us. It helps shape the direction of future episodes, new features, and improvements.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy building your city in the underworld as much as we enjoyed creating it.[/p][p]Get to know more about what's Episode 1 about:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="lDIkdRoRt1I;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Thanks for your supporting! [/p]

notes.title: Another day gone… 24 hours left
notes.notes:
[p]Another day gone.[/p][p]
24 hours left until the Prologue drops.[/p][p]It’s weird, right? We've been working on this for so long, and now it's finally [i]happening[/i].[/p][p]
Just one episode for now. I know I’ve said it a lot… “Episode 1 only, Episode 1 only”… but have you actually seen what this episode is about?[/p][p][/p][p]We just uploaded [b]all the cutscenes from Episode 1[/b], if you're curious, I really recommend watching them before playing. You might start to feel what kind of world this is. The tone. The dread. The... soul of it, maybe?[/p][p][/p][p]Maybe it'll make more sense. Maybe it won’t. Maybe you'll watch it and still go: “What the hell did I just watch?”[/p][p]
But that’s fine too. That’s kind of what this game is.[/p][p]Here's the video: [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="lDIkdRoRt1I;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Full Prologue comes out on August 8. Free to play. Only one episode, but it’s an important one.[/p][p]See you soon in Hell.[/p]

notes.title: Prologue Postponed: Thank You for Your Patience
notes.notes: [h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][h3]We have an important update to share. Our team has made the tough decision to postpone the release of [i]The HELL: Prologue[/i].[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/8d4005c50fbf3f74fd0d4e8f0209375708acfc10.png"][/img][/p][h3]Originally scheduled for July 14, we’re now taking a little more time to polish things up and ensure a smoother, better experience for all of you. This Prologue may be just one episode, but it means a lot to us, it sets the tone for the entire game. We want to make sure it feels right before putting it in your hands.[/h3][p][/p][h3]We’re incredibly sorry for the inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. The new release date will be announced very soon, stay tuned![/h3][p][/p][h3]Thank you again for your continued support and patience. We’re almost there. 🔥[/h3][p][/p][h3]— The Metropolice Team[/h3]

notes.title: Prologue Coming Soon in July!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to officially announce that [b]The HELL: Prologue[/b] will be launching on [b]14 July 2025[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/84cf4faf923e316c00e0dfbaee2905425b04fc52.png"][/img][/p][p]This [b]free version[/b] of the game will give you access to [b]Episode 1 only[/b], a full standalone experience that introduces you to the world of [i]The HELL: City Builder of the Dead[/i]. You’ll step into the role of the Hell Governor for the very first time, guiding lost souls, building your city, and facing off against your first Titan: [b]Namazu[/b], the gluttonous beast beneath the depths.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s a solid start, but just the beginning. The Prologue is meant to give you a real taste of the chaos, choices, and city-building mayhem that lies ahead. We’re still working hard on the remaining episodes for Early Access.[/p][p]
We’ve been working hard to polish this version, and we can’t wait to hear what you think.[/p][p]So, [b]14 July[/b], save the date. We’re almost there.[/p][p]Thanks for being with us on this wild ride.🔥[/p][p]Wishlist the game, follow us, and we’ll see you in Hell.[/p][p]— The Metropolice Team[/p]

A city-builder where souls of the damned from real historical disasters arrive in Hell, and you as the Hell Governor decide their fate.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856810/bb5384f7473f5a70fa47637b866d8df7d9141457.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44856810/07cbe74392e39ed2b1f4a4e0a395f48c4a38596a.png"][/img][/p][p]Our Kickstarter page is now [b]live for preview[/b], and you can already see the rewards we’re planning, what we’ll be working on, and how your support will bring this world to life. Your support means everything to us. Let’s build Hell, together.[/p][p][/p][p]Click [b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thehellbacker/the-hell-city-builder-of-the-dead" style="button"]HERE[/url][/b] to visit![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support![/p][p]From Metropolice Team[/p]

notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT: THE HELL - PROLOGUE COMING SOON!
notes.notes:
[h3]We’re thrilled to announce that The HELL: City Builder of the Dead – Prologue is launching on June 30, 2025! This free-to-play version gives you an early chance to step into the role of Hell’s Governor and experience the core mechanics of our unique city-building strategy game.

In the Prologue, you’ll manage the arrival of souls from a historic natural disaster, build your first sectors in the underworld, and face terrifying challenges—including your first encounter with a monstrous titan. This standalone chapter offers a solid glimpse into the gameplay, systems, and tone of the full game, with no cost to play.

Prepare to command the damned, restore order to chaos, and uncover the twisted logic of the afterlife.[/h3]
